schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: WITH SPRING AS (SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES AS S JOIN PRODUCT AS P ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31'), NOT_SPRING AS ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES AS S JOIN PRODUCT AS P ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31') SELECT DISTINCT SPRING.PRODUCT_ID, SPRING.PRODUCT_NAME FROM SPRING WHERE SPRING.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM NOT_SPRING)

q2_prompt_sql: WITH SPRING AS (SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES AS S JOIN PRODUCT AS P ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31'), NOT_SPRING AS ( SELECT S.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES AS S JOIN PRODUCT AS P ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31') SELECT DISTINCT SPRING.PRODUCT_ID, SPRING.PRODUCT_NAME FROM SPRING WHERE SPRING.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN (SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM NOT_SPRING)
explanation: Q1 selects products whose all sales occurred between 2019-01-01 and 2019-03-31 (inclusive). Q2 selects products that have at least one sale in the spring period but no sale outside that period. These are different logic: Q1 ensures all sales are in the range, Q2 excludes products that have any sale outside the range.
counterexample_dsp: A product with one sale in spring and one sale outside spring will be excluded by Q2 but included by Q1.
